per_pillar_md.P1:
What We See
Manasquan Bank’s governance includes three board directors with explicit technology and risk backgrounds: Ed Skoudis (cybersecurity CEO, Counter Hack/SANS), Aaron Jeter (telecom/technology executive), and Noeleen Doelger (KPMG financial forensics, appointed 2025). CTO Rich Lanza was promoted to EVP in November 2025 — a board confidence signal (E-025-REVISED, E-068). Innovation follows a systematic fintech partnership model: Bakkt digital assets (2021), ZSuite mSuite escrow (2022), Terafina digital opening (2024), Clover POS (E-028, E-047). ESG is the strongest P1 category: $392K in grants, 146 awards, 505+ volunteer hours, NJBankers Community Service Award 2025 (E-045, E-046).
Why It Matters
P1 is the ONLY pillar above peer median (+0.15). The systematic innovation cadence — roughly one strategic fintech partnership per year — signals that CTO Lanza has an established evaluation process. Zennify/Salesforce should position as the NEXT partnership in this established pattern. The award-winning culture (E-075: Indeed 4.7/5.0, 6yr Best Banks) means change adoption risk is LOW.
per_pillar_md.P2:
What We See
Terafina launched digital account opening in February 2024 for all account types (E-047). The bank operates a comprehensive digital center: mobile app, online banking, BillPay, Zelle, mobile deposit, eStatements, alerts. Katie Meyers CCXP was appointed VP/CXO in 2023 (E-038) — a dedicated CX executive role. Nick Martin joined as VP Digital Marketing in November 2025 (E-025-REVISED). But NO CRM platform exists (E-051: Vibe keywords NULL for 9 CRM terms). Marketo handles marketing automation but is lightly utilized (E-050: no case study, no JD mentions). Personalization is limited to Compass Profile, a rules-based tool (E-056).
Why It Matters
P2 scores 0.24 below peers despite having digital channels because the RELATIONSHIP LAYER is missing. Terafina opens accounts digitally, but those accounts disappear into Fiserv core without relationship tracking. The CXO has responsibility for experience but no CRM platform to manage it. FSC is the structural answer — it creates the relationship view across branch, digital, and phone that // all require.
per_pillar_md.P3:
What We See
Transactional automation is strong: Positive Pay with auto-return (E-057), ZSuite mSuite end-to-end escrow (E-028), Cash Recyclers at all 15 branches reducing wait times 50% (E-061). However, enterprise automation is absent — Clay search for 13 RPA/workflow/automation titles returned zero results (E-061, E-062). The 5-person compliance team (SVP Siverio 10+ years, E-064) operates without a detected regtech/GRC platform. BCP/DR exists per FDIC mandate but is not publicly documented (E-066).
Why It Matters
P3 is 0.27 below peers. The gap is at the PROCESS ORCHESTRATION layer, not the transaction layer. Fiserv handles check/ACH processing; mSuite handles escrow. But cross-functional workflows (onboarding routing, compliance case management, RM task queues) are manual. FSC Workflows + Flow + nCino (origination) address this exact layer. The compliance gap (: 1.70) represents both a risk and an opportunity — SVP Siverio’s 10-year tenure means she understands the pain points intimately.
per_pillar_md.P4:
What We See
This is the widest gap between VISION and REALITY. CTO Lanza’s LinkedIn lists “AI | Blockchain | Driving Multi-Million Dollar Transformations” and his promotion PR references a “comprehensive data strategy” (E-068). But Clay searches for 12 data-titled roles returned zero results (E-067). No BI platform, no data warehouse, no CDP detected. CECL (mandatory credit loss modeling) is the only predictive analytics (platform unknown, E-070). Coremetrics/IBM is DISCONTINUED (E-069). FAQ chatbot is the only AI (vendor-provided, E-071). Fiserv Premier (85% confidence) is the core banking platform with Communicator Open APIs available (E-072). ASP.NET 4.0/IIS 8 is legacy website infrastructure (E-073). Cybersecurity is the exception: 3-person InfoSec team, board Skoudis, InfraGard, clean breach record (E-074).
Why It Matters
P4 is 0.40 below peers — the largest gap. Data Cloud is THE implementation vehicle for the CTO’s aspirational data strategy. The no-code approach is critical: MBNK has no data engineers and won’t hire them (253 total employees, community bank economics). Embedded Tableau provides analytics without an analyst team. The CECL enrichment angle is strategic — regulatory mandates don’t require discretionary budget approval. Cybersecurity strength (: 2.01) means Shield is an add-on, not a selling point.
